from textual.app import ComposeResult
from textual.containers import Container
from textual.widgets import RichLog
from textual.app import App

class LogViewerApp(App):
    """A minimal scrollable log viewer app."""
    
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Container(RichLog(id="log_widget"))
    
    def on_mount(self):
        """Initialize the log widget."""
        self.log_widget = self.query_one("#log_widget", RichLog)
        self.add_log_line("Log viewer started")
    
    def add_log_line(self, line: str) -> None:
        """Append a single line to the log."""
        self.log_widget.write(line)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = LogViewerApp()
    app.run()
